say:2:1623232001:0.text: B-But... that was my best hay... saved all autumn... for winter... Now it's all gone.
say:2:1623232001:0.source_cn: 这……可是我攒了整个秋天的上等干草……准备过冬的……现...

say:3:1623232002:1.text: You're worried about hay? We could've been burned alive if we'd spotted it any later!
say:3:1623232002:1.source_cn: 这是草料被烧的问题吗？刚才的火势多危险！要不是发现得早...

say:5:1623232003:0.text: The words strike a nerve. The animals erupt at once, voices piling over one another.
say:5:1623232003:0.source_cn: 这番话引起了动物们的共鸣，大家七嘴八舌地附和起来。

say:7:1623232004:0.text: Exactly! The forest used to be peaceful—then you two showed up. And quit sweeping the leaves like they're dirt! They feed the soil, protect roots, and make the forest look like itself!
say:7:1623232004:0.source_cn: 说得对！你们来了之后森林就没安宁过！你为什么非要清扫落...

say:8:1623232005:0.text: And that endless swish-swish-swish! It follows you everywhere. Got my fur standing up all day long. That noise doesn't belong out here.
say:8:1623232005:0.source_cn: 还有那没完没了的沙沙声！走到哪儿响到哪儿，吵得我神经紧...

say:9:1623232006:0.text: A-And he cleared the grass covering my burrow, leaving my babies totally exposed without shelter...
say:9:1623232006:0.source_cn: 他……他还把我窝边用来伪装的草都清理掉了，差点让我的孩...

say:14:1623232008:2.text: Hold it. Here's the real problem! You're seriously letting a walking flame wander around the woods?! Today it's hay... Next time what, the whole forest?
say:14:1623232008:2.source_cn: 等等！最根本的问题是，你们真的打算让一个小火苗在森林里...

say:19:1623232010:0.text: Candel's tip droops. Sweep's light dims to a small, shaken glow. Both of them look crushed.

choice_prompt:20:1623232010.text: Candel's tip droops. Sweep's light dims to a small, shaken glow. Both of them look crushed.
choice_prompt:20:1623232010.source_cn: 坎德尔的扫把头耷拉下来，斯威普的烛光也变得微弱，两人显得十分难过。

say:22:1623232011:0.text: Well... they don't live or die by the forest the way we do, so they don't understand our rules... or our fears...
say:22:1623232011:0.source_cn: 唉……说到底，他们不依靠森林就能活下来，因此低估了我们...

choice_prompt:23:1623232011.text: Well... they don't live or die by the forest the way we do, so they don't understand our rules... or our fears...
choice_prompt:23:1623232011.source_cn: 唉……说到底，他们不依靠森林就能活下来，因此低估了我们的难处，也不在意森林的忌讳……

say:24:1623232012:0.text: You're a good friend of the woods, Magister. But... you can't watch them every second.
say:24:1623232012:0.source_cn: 不是我们不相信你，魔法师大人。只是……你总不能时时刻刻...
say:24:1623232012:0.male: You're a good friend of the woods, Magister. But... you can't watch them every second.
say:24:1623232012:0.female: You're a good friend of the woods, Magister. But... you can't watch them every second.

say:25:1623232013:0.text: If you hadn't stepped in when you did... the thought alone is terrifying...
say:25:1623232013:0.source_cn: 不过……刚才要不是魔法师大人及时出手……后果真不敢想……
say:25:1623232013:0.male: If you hadn't stepped in when you did... the thought alone is terrifying...
say:25:1623232013:0.female: If you hadn't stepped in when you did... the thought alone is terrifying...

say:27:1623232014:1.text: We owe you thanks, Magister. But we also hope this fire finally teaches them something real.
say:27:1623232014:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，我们必须要感谢你。但我们也希望这次火灾能给...
say:27:1623232014:1.male: We owe you thanks, Magister. But we also hope this fire finally teaches them something real.
say:27:1623232014:1.female: We owe you thanks, Magister. But we also hope this fire finally teaches them something real.

say:28:1623232015:1.text: These two... I don't think they belong here!
say:28:1623232015:1.source_cn: 他们……我觉得他们不适合森林！
say:28:1623232015:1.male: These two... I don't think they belong here!
say:28:1623232015:1.female: These two... I don't think they belong here!
